title: 1952 MIT Lincoln Lab audio of DoD saucer briefing

tellings.quote: >> Yeah. So MIT Lincoln Labs, we found out that there was a realtore audio um file from um way back in the 40s. I'm no sorry, it's like 1952 >> where you have a um a senior official with the Department of Defense um briefing scientists at MIT about the about saucers.

plain: A 1952 audio recording exists of a senior Department of Defense official briefing scientists at MIT about flying saucers, according to Eric Burlison, a member of Congress. He tells Michels it turned up at MIT's Lincoln Laboratory, a defense research lab, and at first places it in the 1940s before correcting himself to 1952. If true, it would show the Pentagon talking about saucers with top scientists that early.
